summary: Spawns a burst of particles when the emitter has available slot capacity. Computes spread/velocity scales from a5 and the a4 spread vector, selects a time scale through the scoring gate or a fallback global, obtains a collision normal from feature data, fetches a base velocity through virtual dispatch, then loops over the detail-adjusted particle count allocating slots from a circular buffer, seeding randomized position and velocity from a noise table, and setting up a billboard quad for each slot.

local_names.v45: position triple used for collision query

operations.description: Skip emission entirely when the emitter slot capacity at this+0x58 is not positive
Convert the particle count a5 into a scale and a half-scale, and halve each axis of the a4 spread vector

Choose the emission time scale: when the scoring gate dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, read vehicle data via VehicleDataAccessor on dword_8AB6EC and use FloatDifference unless the result is 5 (then 0); otherwise fall back to the global dbl_8AFE98
Multiply the scaled a4 axes by the chosen scale to form per-axis velocity offsets and copy the a2 position into the local context
Compute a collision normal for position a2 against the feature data global dbl_7C9360 via CollisionNormalFromFeature
On collision success derive a feature alignment value from the normal and the a2 axes; on failure default the normal to (0,1,0) and the alignment marker to -3.4028235e38
Fetch the base velocity from the session manager dword_5EA510 via VirtualDispatchHelper and read three velocity components from the returned data
Set the emission time base: when the scoring gate equals 2 delegate via Delegation on dword_8AB6EC, otherwise take the session time global dbl_8AFEA0
Compute the actual particle count by right-shifting a3 by the emitter detail level at this+0x8
Loop over the computed particle count, allocating one slot per particle via CircularBufferSlotAlloc
Seed each slot: store the emission time base, then derive randomized position and velocity components from the noise table flt_8AB274, advancing the counter dword_8AAE70
Write the collision normal components and the alignment marker into the slot fields
Compute the billboard quad axis vector from the difference between the spawned velocity and the base velocity, scaled by 0.03125
Set up the billboard quad for the slot via ParticleEffectBillboardQuadSetup

clean_pseudocode: seed slot position/velocity from noise table flt_8AB274 and counter dword_8AAE70;
